text:
incident-bot: Alert: elevated 5xx and p95 latency in eu-central-1 for Hosted API and Dedicated pools. Metric spike started ~6298765400. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat, and embeddings. Error mix: 502/503/504.
ben_oncall: I’m on it. Seeing increased connection errors to AWS NLBs + STS timeouts in the region. Paging infra.
alice_sre: adding quick health checks. Running curl against edge gateway: `curl -I https://hosted-api.eu-central-1.example.com/v1/health` -> intermittent 502s and long TTFB (~2.5s).
dave_infra: Dedicated pools in eu-central show request queue depth growth and KV cache pressure. Instances still up but enqueueing. Possible upstream (AWS) target group failures.
carla_prod: Customer impact? Are PLG free-tier customers being throttled or errors returned? Need ETA for comms.
ben_oncall: Early estimate: impacting ~20% of Hosted API traffic for EU customers, and Dedicated pools in eu-central with bursty latency; customers on pinned capacity still get slower tail latency. Not seeing data loss but increased error surface.
maya_support: Preparing a short status note for customers. Please confirm: is fallback to other regions safe for Dedicated pools with data residency?
dave_infra: For Hosted API we can route-eject eu-central for new requests and shift to eu-west-1. For Dedicated, tenants with strict region pinning will see degraded perf; we can offer temporary cross-region failover per-customer but need security signoff.
ben_oncall: I'm going to start automated routing override for Hosted API (canary then full) and scale up eu-west capacity. `kubectl exec -it router -- curl -X POST /admin/weight -d '{"eu-central-1":0.1}'` (doing canary).
alice_sre: From logs: repeated `504 upstream read timeout` from `aws-nginx` and `Failed to get credentials from STS` entries. Pasted sample: ```[2026-02-12T14:23:10Z] handler.go:114 - upstream error: dial tcp 10.0.12.45:443: connect: connection timed out```
logstream-bot: Notice: LogStream ingestion backlog in eu-central since 6298765300, ingest-latency = 450s, alerting delayed. We may be missing some real-time traces.
ben_oncall: Good catch @logstream-bot — observability delays mean our dashboards lag by ~5-7min. Use direct instance logs if you need live data.
carla_prod: @maya_support draft: "We're investigating elevated latencies and 5xx responses affecting EU customers in eu-central-1. We're routing traffic to neighboring regions; some dedicated customers may experience degraded latency. We'll provide updates in 30 minutes." ok? :thinking:
maya_support: LGTM, will send once Ben confirms routing change outcome.
olivia_next_oncall: I’m taking on-call at +20m; if you need immediate handoff, @ben_oncall drop a short summary and approximate time to hand off.
ben_oncall: Handoff in 18m. Current actions: 1) Canary routing override for Hosted API (eu-central -> eu-west) 2) Scale eu-west pooled capacity + pre-warm model caches 3) Open support playbook for pinned Dedicated tenants 4) Notify customers via status page.
dave_infra: AWS status shows `Partial network disruption` for eu-central NLBs and STS in the past hour. Link: https://status.aws.amazon.com/incidents/.. (internal link attached).
alice_sre: Quick mitigation note: enabling shorter upstream timeouts on nginx reduces tail error amplification. Doing rolling change to `proxy_read_timeout 30s` -> currently at 60s.
ben_oncall: Canary traffic cutover succeeded for a subset of traffic. Error rate dropped ~40% for canary slice. Rolling to 100% over next 6m unless we see regression.
carla_prod: Good. Maya, please queue an update to customers noting routing change and estimated next update in 30m.
maya_support: Sent initial status update to status.redwood.ai (incidents page). DMing top-tier customers.
olivia_next_oncall: Took on-call; thanks @ben_oncall. Summary received. I’ll monitor runbooks and manage the customer communications channel.
ben_oncall: handing off now — leaving doc with notes in #incidents runbook and pinging infra slackbot to keep a live trace.
logstream-bot: Update: ingestion backlog shrinking after retries; real-time traces still partial.
dave_infra: After routing shift and scale, p95 latency down to baseline ~130ms and 5xx down to normal range. Some Dedicated pools still seeing elevated queueing for pinned tenants; working individual remediation.
carla_prod: Prioritize dedicated tenants with SLAs and notify them individually. Schedule postmortem with infra and SRE.
alice_sre: Final check: running synthetic suite against endpoints — all green for eu-west route. Will keep watch for 1hr.
ben_oncall: Incident status -> mitigated. Creating incident ticket and assigning postmortem. Thanks team. :tada:
